Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5 applies in Los Angeles, CA (CA statewide rule). Rule: 1 month's rent (2 months for qualifying small landlords).

Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.6 applies in Los Angeles, CA (CA statewide rule). Rule: $30 base per applicant, CPI-adjusted annually since 1998 ($68.96 for 2026 per Berkeley Rent Board). Note: open question: No single official 2026 CPI-adjusted dollar figure appears in the statute; the $68.96 figure comes from the Berkeley Rent Board page (D005).
Cal. Gov. Code § 12955 applies in Los Angeles, CA (CA statewide rule). Rule: Source of income (incl. vouchers) is a protected characteristic.

California FEHA criminal history protections (Civil Rights Council regulations) applies in Los Angeles, CA (CA statewide rule). Rule: No blanket bans; no arrests without conviction, sealed/expunged or juvenile records.
